Deferred items (multi-engine qualification, self-contained npm distribution, Phase-1b identity/state/rotation) are register-tracked, never silently claimed, and §8's non-claims preserve the trust model's honest limits. No plan-internal contradiction found; consistent with fail-closed, closed-set, content-addressed identity, no-mutable-label-keying, and zero-dependency-core invariants.
